data.name: Azraeel
data.gender_notes: Azraeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Azraeel is derived from the Hebrew language, and it means ‘The Almighty One,’ ‘The Helper of God,’ or ‘God’s Wrath.’ In Islamic tradition, Azraeel is considered the Angel of Death, and he is responsible for taking the souls of the deceased. The name Azraeel carries the meaning “The Almighty One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azraeel usually hope their child will grow to embody the almighty one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Azraeel represents the concept of divine justice, as he is the one who takes the souls of the deceased and brings them to the Creator. It is a reminder of the transience of life and the importance of living in accordance with God's will.
data.etymology: Azraeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Almighty One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azraeel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عزرائيل
in_arabic.meaning: الله تعالی کا ملائکہ موت کا حامل
in_arabic.long_meaning: عزرائيل اللہ تعالی کے فرشتوں میں سے ایک ہیں جو موت کے فرشتے کے نام سے مشہور ہیں۔ ان کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی ہوا ہے۔ عزرائيل کا معنی ہے 'الله تعالی کی مدد' یا 'الله تعالی کا طاقتور ایک'۔

in_urdu.name: عزرائيل
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزرائيل اللہ تعالیٰ کے ایک فرشتے کا نام ہے جو موت کے فرشتے کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں ہوا ہے۔ عزرائيل کا نام عزر (عزر) اور ائیل (ائل) سے بنا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'مدد' اور 'اللہ تعالیٰ'۔ یہ فرشتہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے موت کے وقت انسانوں کی روحوں کو قبض کرنے کے لئے भेजا جاتا ہے۔

in_english.name: Azraeel
in_english.meaning: Angel of Death in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Azraeel, also known as Azrail, is an angel in Islamic tradition who serves as the angel of death. He is responsible for taking the souls of the deceased at the time of death. The name Azraeel is derived from the Arabic roots 'azr' meaning 'to help' and 'eel' meaning 'God'. Azraeel is mentioned in the Quran and is considered a significant figure in Islamic eschatology, representing the divine process of guiding souls to the afterlife.
